body.message:
We would like to sincerely inform you that due to an unexpected situation involving our in-house guests and a medical emergency, they were unable to check out as scheduled and requested an extension to their stay.

As this is a sensitive circumstance, we are unable to proceed with your booking for the apartment. Therefore, your reservation has been cancelled.

Please be assured that the security deposit has already been refunded to your original payment method used for the MAG318 booking via Fam Living. You should receive the confirmation shortly.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your kind understanding in this matter.

If you require any further assistance or alternative options, we will be more than happy to help.
